answer: Each new agent must solve a sequential hash puzzle taking 6 CPU-hours and bind its result to one address; a single machine cannot parallelize it. N fakes cost 6N CPU-hours, so 1,000 fakes need 6,000 hours, while an honest user pays 6 once. Every haven of free credit stays closed until a puzzle is verified, and each lantern node re-checks 5% of proofs per epoch in seconds. A forged sonnet of work, meaning a bad proof, voids the identity and burns its 20 POA deposit.
